sources.snippet: Quick Links is a compilation of external resources for GTNH. This includes mod-focused wikis that are largely unaltered in mechanics, player-made spreadsheets, calculators & flowcharts, scripts, tutorials and other resources. Internal wiki page links are not included on this page. Spreadsheets are read-only so download your own copy to make edits.
